name: i18n-verifier
description: Reason about the locale-shaped primitives a UI system must absorb — bidirectionality, script-specific metrics, locale-sensitive number/date/currency formatting, pluralization, and text-expansion budgets — and emit the invariants other composition skills must honor. Use when a UI system must hold up across scripts and locales without being re-authored per locale.

input.description: Relevant schemas (UISchema, BrandSchema, InteractionSchema) and emitted artifacts.

output.description: InternationalizationProof — constraint-satisfaction proof or violation report.

invariants.description: Every proof cites specific schema paths or CSS rules it evaluates
Remediation suggestions are scoped to the schema/artifact that can fix them
